senses.gloss:
1. मुद् मुद्, i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., Rām. 1, 46, 17), To be delighted, to rejoice, Man. 2, 232.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मुदित, Delighted, Pañc. i. d. 458; Chr. 14, 24. n. Pleasure.
 --Caus. To exhilarate (also Ātm.), Bhaṭṭ. 7, 171.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To approve, to permit, MBh. 2, 1787.
 2. To rejoice, MBh. 3, 11535.
 --Caus. To celebrate, Chr. 55, 3. अनुमोदित, Agreed, Utt. Rāmac. 38, 18.
 --With अभ्यनु अभि-अनु, To dismiss, MBh. 1, 4447.
 --With प्र प्र, To be delighted, Rām. 1, 1, 84. प्रमुदित, Pleased, happy, Pañc. 238, 23.
 --Caus. To exhilarate, Man. 3, 61. प्रमोदित, Happy. m. A name of Kuvera.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To expect with delight, MBh. 1, 6781.
2. मुद् मुद्, i. 10, Par. To mix.

3. मुद् 1. मुद्, f.
 1. Pleasure, joy, Pañc. 159, 20; Kir. 5, 25.
 2. Intoxication.
 3. A wife.
 --Comp.
मुदा 1. मुद् + आ, f. Joy, pleasure, Chr. 13, 19; 35, 10.

मुदिर 1. मुद् + इर, m.
 1. A cloud.
 2. A lover.

मुद्ग मुद्ग, m.
 1. A sort of kidney bean, Phaseolus mungo, Lass. 79, 15.
 2. A cover.

मुद्गर मुद्गर, m.
 1. A carpenter's hammer.
 2. A mace, Rām. 3, 54, 10; Sund. 2, 3.
 3. A staff armed with iron, used for breaking clods of earth.
 4. A sort of flower.
 --Comp.

मुद्रा मुद्रा, f.
 1. A seal, a signet, Pañc. iv. d. 36 (स्त्री-, woman who is, as it were, the seal, i. e. the order, viz. of the god of love).
 2. A seal-ring.
 3. A stamp, figurat., a form, Utt. Rāmac. 155, 3.
 4. A mode of intertwining the fingers during religious worship, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 12.
 --Comp.

मुद्रिका मुद्रिका, i. e. मुद्रा + क, f. = मुद्रा.
 --Comp.

मुद्रित मुद्रित, i. e. मुद्रा + इत, adj.
 1. Sealed.
 2. Stamped, marked, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 3; written, Hit. iv. d. 10.
 3. Sealed up, contracted,
 4. Unblown (as a flower).
